messages.text: Hi Sarah, Are you an AI assistent?
Yes, I'm the team's automated first line here, and a person steps in when something needs one. What can I help you with?
how do you calculate the DDP shipping price of any product

We don't sell DDP. Every price is USD excluding VAT and duties, and checkout doesn't collect import tax. Shipping cost is calculated at checkout from your address. Duties and import VAT are billed by the carrier or customs on delivery, so we can't quote that figure in advance. For the EU that's 21% import VAT on units shipping from our US or Canada warehouse; units held in our EU warehouse have VAT included already.

Where are you shipping to? I'll tell you exactly which applies.
I am shipping it to India

India is Rest of World, so the same rule: the price is the unit only, and Indian customs and GST are raised on delivery by the carrier. We don't collect them at checkout and we can't quote what your customs office will charge. Shipping itself you'll see at checkout once you enter the address.

I've asked the team to confirm anything specific to India for you. They're offline now and pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email.

What's the best email for you, and which unit are you looking at?

thats ok. I checked with Helium Team on whatsapp. so lets say if a product costs 500 USD and the full DDP price is shown as 40 USD for instance, then any extra charge by teh customs in India will have to be taken care by the buyer himself which is not exactly what DDP shipping is

You're right, that's not DDP. If a shipping line is labelled DDP, duties should be prepaid and nothing extra should land on you. What I can tell you for certain is our stated rule: prices exclude duties and import tax, and customs bills the recipient. I can't confirm what that $40 line covers, so I won't guess.

I've put it to the team to confirm exactly how that India line is labelled and settled.
